_doc: Binaries shipped with the installer next to the server (SPEC-v3 V7, brief 1: resources/bin). Every entry needs name, version, license (SPDX expression) and source. Pinned downloads (url, sha256) and the build steps live in desktop/packaging/third-party.json and desktop/scripts/stage.js; keep both files in step. stage.js fails the build when the ffmpeg configure line contains --enable-gpl or --enable-nonfree.

binaries.name: ffmpeg / ffprobe (Windows build)
binaries.note: Built by desktop/scripts/build-ffmpeg-windows.sh (Linux, mingw-w64 GCC win32 thread model; Docker image and toolchain versions pinned in desktop/packaging/third-party.json) with exactly the configure line above: no GPL, no non-free, no version3, no autodetected libraries. Shared DLLs (avcodec, avformat, avfilter, avdevice, avutil, swscale, swresample) next to ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe, so they can be replaced; the build checks that they import only Windows system DLLs and each other. External code inside: listed under bundled (OpenH264 and libvpl in avcodec, zlib, NVENC headers; GCC and MinGW-w64 runtime parts linked statically). Licence texts ship in resources/licenses/ffmpeg (with BUILDINFO.txt). NVENC needs an NVIDIA driver 531.61 or newer.

bundled.name: OpenH264
bundled.note: H.264 encoder (libopenh264) in avcodec, compiled from source; Cisco's patent coverage applies only to Cisco's own binaries.

bundled.name: libvpl (Intel Video Processing Library dispatcher)
bundled.note: Intel Quick Sync (h264_qsv) in avcodec; loads the Intel runtime from the driver at run time.

bundled.name: nv-codec-headers
bundled.note: Headers only (NVENC, h264_nvenc); the NVIDIA driver is loaded at run time.

bundled.name: GCC runtime libraries (libgcc, libstdc++)
bundled.note: Linked statically (-static-libgcc; libstdc++ for OpenH264 and libvpl). The GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1 exempts the compiled program from the GPL: no GPL obligations attach to ffmpeg.

bundled.name: MinGW-w64 runtime (static CRT parts)
bundled.note: Startup code and libmingwex helpers linked statically; some files are public domain. The C runtime itself is msvcrt.dll from Windows.

binaries.name: ffmpeg / ffprobe (macOS build)
binaries.note: Built by desktop/scripts/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh with exactly the configure line above. Static executables with no third-party library inside (bundled is empty): zlib, VideoToolbox and AudioToolbox are system libraries of macOS, linked dynamically. Corresponding source: the pinned ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz and that build script.

binaries.name: uv
binaries.note: Creates the component virtual environments (SPEC-v3 V3.1). LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE of the 0.13.1 tag ship in resources/licenses/uv.
